name: fdm_craftbotflow_common
machine_end_gcode:
G92 E1
G1 E-1 F300
G101 Z10 ; Lower the bed by 10 mm
G28 X ; Home X
G1 Y200 F{travel_speed*60} ; Move the bed away from the camera
{if is_idex_printer}
M104 S0 T0 ; Turn off left extruder
M104 S0 T1 ; Turn off right extruder
{else}
M104 S0 ; Turn off extruder
{endif}
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed
M107 ; Turn off fan
M84 ; Disable motors
